item.title: After missing deadline, DOJ says it may need a ‘few more weeks’ to finish releasing Epstein files
item.description: The Justice Department said Wednesday that it may need a “few more weeks" to release all of its records on the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein after suddenly discovering more than a million potentially relevant documents, further delaying compliance with last Friday’s congressionally mandated deadline.
